explanation: Aïn Séfra, a town in Algeria on the desert's northern edge, has seen snow several times, including in 1979 and 2018, and it has even settled on the dunes.

claims.text: Snow has fallen in parts of the Sahara Desert.
Snow fell at Aïn Séfra, in Algeria, in 1979 and in 2018.
Aïn Séfra lies on the northern edge of the Sahara.
Snow has settled on sand dunes near Aïn Séfra.
